metadata.evaluator: AI playtester using an experienced digital-card-game critique perspective; not a human expert
metadata.mode: independent blind assessment; no prior review artifacts, scores, implementation logs, or sibling reports read before score commitment
metadata.uiActivationCountNote: Not instrumented; native recorded choices are not a count of all browser clicks, inspections, menus, or payment plan activations.
metadata.historyNote: Actual public final state is preserved in full. Its history array contains the most recent 150 of 358 events. Complete recorded choices and configuration are preserved in session for deterministic reconstruction.
metadata.sessionCapture: Read-only window.localTable.state and window.localTable.session after natural terminal.
metadata.inputMethod: Real owned rendered browser DOM button clicks and UI inputs only; no engine.choose, worker messages, native hidden-state inspection, source edits, preference changes or deck saves.
metadata.snapshotLimitations: Later midgame/final preview snapshots timed out; tool returned PreviewAutomationTimeoutError for final snapshot. Earlier screenshots succeeded.
